column1: # Game profile of Mario Tennis Aces (Switch, update 3.1.1 = v851968). Brought up on the Mac: the title, the opening movies, the start of Adventure, the main menu and a Free Play singles match to its end
# Camelot's engine with NintendoWare (G3d, Ui2d, Vfx, Atk, Font) and NEX / Pia networking, on SDK 4.5.0, NVN; subsdk0 is the SDK's movie library (its WebM / VP9 movies).
# RomFS is mostly Camelot's NARC archives (.narc, .ntex, .nptl, some .bin): the Nitro layout with members packed by type byte (zlib, deflate, Camelot's LZ, LZ4), which hold the models' and
# effects' BNSH (dm/gfx/tools/shader_split.py narc_members). What it needed from the host is general: the font engine's heap (hle_sdk16.c), SDK 4's base-object movie decoder constructor
# (hle_movie.c), compact command records and CopyCommands as a copy (hle_nvn.c: thousands of per-object command buffers sized by GetCommandMemoryUsed in a 16 MB pool, copied then
# recorded again), and an sRGB render target read through a linear texture object on the same storage (nvn_mtl.m tex_mtl_)
# Local wireless over the LAN (hle_ldn.c, ldn_mitm's protocol) through the host's sockets (hle_sock.c): the launcher's Local play switch, on by default
# no system resource: main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB in the 4 GB layout's 3.25 GB heap region (3.14 GB here); about 1.4 GB resident on the Mac through the menus
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon
# 21,703 shaders, almost all in the NARC members (models, effects, the deferred passes' .z4 archives), 40 in main
